name: Cloudinary
description: Cloudinary's hosted asset-management server uploads, searches and transforms images and video in your account.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (asset-management.mcp.cloudinary.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
